comment: Main-image owners proven to match no ordinary C: a hand-written seal concluding a bounded search, recording that every admissible source shape was tried and the retained assembly is the honest owner. A seal is a human judgment, never tool output, and it is contradicted -- and must be revisited -- if an ordinary exact candidate later appears. The opposite register to games/gs1/src/provisional.json, which holds exact owners whose source is contrived. Empty is the goal.
